biography: Sarin Carlesso, a name whispered with both excitement and frustration in Brazilian motorsport circles, hails from the sun-drenched favelas of Rio de Janeiro. His introduction to racing wasn't through karting circuits, but rather navigating the chaotic streets on a battered scooter, delivering groceries for his family. A chance encounter with a local mechanic, impressed by Sarin's uncanny ability to anticipate traffic flow, led to an opportunity to work on race cars. He absorbed everything, devouring technical manuals and spending countless hours in the garage. His break came when a driver fell ill, and Sarin, at 17, stepped in, stunning everyone with a raw, untamed talent. He quickly rose through the ranks, attracting attention with his aggressive yet calculated style. Now, at 21, Sarin is a rising star in the MetalMoro MRX Duratec Turbo P3 series, balancing the expectations of a nation with the pressure of proving himself on the international stage. He carries the weight of his community on his shoulders, a constant reminder of where he came from and what he's fighting for.
drivingStyle: Carlesso's driving style is a fascinating blend of defensive prowess and opportunistic aggression. He's known for his exceptional car control, particularly in wet conditions, where he seems to anticipate the limits of grip with almost preternatural accuracy. He is a master of late-braking maneuvers, often positioning his car defensively to force rivals into making mistakes. While not always the fastest outright, Sarin excels at tire management and maintaining consistent lap times under pressure, turning races into strategic battles of attrition.

rivalries.name: Ricardo Vargas
rivalries.reason: A long-standing rivalry stemming from their karting days, fueled by contrasting personalities and aggressive on-track battles. Vargas, the son of a wealthy industrialist, represents everything Sarin has fought against.

rivalries.name: Isabela Fonseca
rivalries.reason: A fierce competitor in the MetalMoro series, Fonseca and Carlesso have clashed repeatedly, their contrasting driving styles leading to several on-track incidents and heated exchanges in the paddock.

rivalries.name: Kenji Tanaka
rivalries.reason: Tanaka accused Carlesso of overly aggressive defensive driving during a crucial championship race, sparking a war of words and intensifying their rivalry.

quirks: Always wears the same worn-out bracelet his grandmother gave him before every race.
Refuses to look at the starting grid before the formation lap, claiming it brings bad luck.
Listens to a specific samba song on repeat in the moments leading up to the race.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't just about speed, it's about survival. And in Rio, we learn to survive."
careerHighlight: Winning the MetalMoro MRX Duratec Turbo P3 championship race at Interlagos in 2023, in front of his home crowd, after starting from the back of the grid due to a mechanical issue in qualifying.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of the Brazilian Endurance Championship race at Curitiba in 2022, costing his team the championship title.
